KA-NEWS February 6, 1981. 


Hi! / Bonjour! 


We have had a number of staff enquiring about K.K. 81. Because I've only started 
back downtown things have been held up so included please find one Returnee Staff 
application (or a new Staff Application for former C.I.T.). If you are interested 


in joining us for another summer, send it back at your earliest convenience because 


we are going to start hiring personnel very shortly. 


Now for some Ka-News, Nancy and I are getting married February 28, for those of 
you who have not heard. 


Staff salaries have gone up a $100-$200 in all areas. 


Julien worked on the Boating waterfront area, it looks better and has a fireplace, 
also the Totem pole still stands. Dave Benetthas now finished school, Jim Pelton 
is becoming a Philosophical Painter, John Kennedy also has attached a paint brush 
to his trombone, Doug Peets has sold over $1,000 worth of advertising in the K.K. 
Brochure, the money will be used on equipment. Sue Gottman has gone to Israel ona 
study Program, Larry Lacey is just loving teaching, Larry Cobb is back out west, 
hope to see him in March. 


On of these days I'm going to try X-Country skiing. 


Hope to hear from you soon, and happy Valentines. 


Ban. 


Dave. 
/fas 
KAMP KANAWANA IN THE LAURENTIANS KANAWANA 
SINCE 1894 OUTING 


LES VOYAGEURS DANS LES LAURENTIDES 
DE LA VERENDRYE DEPUIS 1894 CLUB
